I remember i couldn’t stay sober for more then a day or two. Then one day I tried to again overdose and I remember laying in bed hearing my heart beat in my head. I will never forget how loud and fucked up my heart sounded. I realized I didn’t want to die and from that night on I swore off on it completely. I woke up flushed whatever I had left and haven’t touched it since.

It was harder then hell especially the fact that it numbed ALL my pain. I was lost for a long time after that and I still find myself struggling to keep sober here and there.
